text.main_curriculum_text: I am a Computer Science student at IFCE and I am interested in part-time job opportunities in the Information Technology area. As I attend classes in the afternoon, I am available to work in the morning or at night. I am looking for a position that allows me to apply the knowledge acquired at college, while continuing to develop new skills and contribute to the company.

projects.name: Asteroid in C
projects.description: 🎮 2D Game made with Raylib, Asteroids in C is a 2D game inspired in the era of Snes games, developed with C using Raylib library. I made this game to test my knowledge in the C programming language.

projects.name: Pong in C
projects.description: 🎮 Pong project made in C language using the Raylib graphics library, a 2D game inspired by the classic Ping Pong which was the starting point for the creation of video games.

projects.name: Weather App
projects.description: 🌤️ Weather Forecast App built with Jetpack Compose and FastAPI. WeatherApp is a weather forecast application developed using Jetpack Compose and a FastAPI backend, utilizing the OpenWeather API to provide accurate and real-time weather data.

projects.name: TaskMan App
projects.description: 📋 This is a task list project developed with Flutter. I created the app with the goal of learning the Dart language and the Flutter frontend framework, an excellent declarative UI framework.
